'''''Ruta angustifolia''''', the '''narrow-leaved fringed rue''', is a small shrub belonging to the [[Rutaceae]] family. It is native to the Mediterranean, and has been adapted to various parts of the world.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Bailly |first=Christian |date=2023-02-13 |title=''Ruta angustifolia'' Pers. (Narrow-Leaved Fringed Rue): Pharmacological Properties and Phytochemical Profile |url=https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9959652/ |journal=Plants |volume=12 |issue=4 |pages=827 |doi=10.3390/plants12040827  |doi-access=free|issn=2223-7747 |pmc=9959652 |pmid=36840175}}</ref>

== Distribution ==

It is found in Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia, Italy, Sicily, Yugoslavia, Corsica, France, Portugal, Sardinia and Spain.<ref name=POWO/>
